data.title: 菲亚梅塔 · 花摊前
data.description: 她在花摊前选了很久，最后挑了颜色明亮的一束。店主问要写什么卡片，她想了想，只留下自己的名字。
data.camera: 中景，花摊与纸包装同框
data.promptProse: Amidst a lively, sun-drenched street flower market, Fiammetta carefully inspects a vibrant bouquet of sunflowers and lavender at a rustic street stall. Woven baskets, vibrant floral displays, and colorful signage for the stall create a cheerful background, while bright daylight enhances the brilliant, contrasting colors of the flowers and her focused, soft gaze.
